leads.notes: Full master bathroom update. Demolition of old tub, modern walk-in tile shower installation, custom double vanity, and new lighting fixtures.
Subway tile backsplash replacement around island and stove wall. Under-cabinet accent LED strip wiring needed.
Replacing damaged cedar deck boards, reinforcing joists, and applying fresh weatherproofing stain.

testing_requirements.rule: Every key element MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) to prevent text collision.
Add hover micro-interactions to all buttons and card items.
Ensure contrast ratio exceeds WCAG AA standards using dark theme (#09090B base with #18181B panels and #F97316 accent).
Always include data-testid on critical elements.
